Service

Focused time with a senior design mind.

Short, structured engagements for product teams and founders who need a clear perspective on a design challenge — without the overhead of a full engagement. Come with a specific question; leave with a direct answer and a written follow-up.

Remote

Video call

Fast

Same-week availability

Direct

No filler

Session Types

Available formats.

Design Audit

90 min

A focused review of your existing product with prioritized recommendations for improvement. You bring the product, I bring 15 years of pattern recognition. You leave with a clear list of what to fix first and why.

Best for

Teams preparing for a redesign or needing an outside perspective before investing further.

AI UX Strategy

2 hours

A deep-dive on how to approach AI product design: trust models, human-in-the-loop patterns, explainability, and what your team should prioritize in the next 90 days. Grounded in real AI product work, not theory.

Best for

Product teams shipping AI features who need a senior design perspective on the experience strategy.

Advisory Session

60 min

A structured conversation on a specific design challenge — roadmap prioritization, team structure, hiring decisions, or how to approach a thorny UX problem. You bring a focused question; I bring a direct answer.

Best for

Founders, heads of product, and design leads who need a senior sounding board without a long engagement.

Team Workshop

Half or full day

A facilitated working session for your design or product team. Topics include AI-native UX, design systems strategy, enterprise UX principles, or a custom topic matched to your team's current challenges.

Best for

Teams that want to upskill together or align on a design direction in a structured format.

What to expect

How a session works.

01

Share context

Before any session, I ask for a brief written summary of the challenge, a product link or screenshots, and any relevant background. No decks required — just enough to come prepared.

02

The session

Sessions are focused and direct. I come with a point of view, not a list of open questions. Expect candor: I will tell you what I actually think, not what is comfortable to say.

03

Written follow-up

After every session, I send a concise written summary: key decisions, recommendations, and suggested next steps. Something you can share with your team and act on immediately.
